summary: PORTMSTR is the Portfolio Master File maintenance program — a callable CRUD service. It is invoked with a command area (LS-COMMAND-AREA) carrying a single-letter command (C/R/U/D) and a portfolio record. It opens the indexed PORTFILE (I-O) and dispatches: Create validates then WRITEs, Read READs and returns the record, Update validates then REWRITEs (and logs an audit record), Delete DELETEs. Validation enforces a portfolio-ID format ('PORT' + numeric), a required name, and a status of A/I/C. Any error routes to a common error routine that sets the return code and returns. Error conditions handled: invalid command, open failure, invalid data, duplicate key, not-found, and generic VSAM errors.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
SELECT CASE command (LS-COMMAND)
  WHEN 'C' (create): CALL 2000-CREATE-PORTFOLIO
  WHEN 'R' (read):   CALL 3000-READ-PORTFOLIO
  WHEN 'U' (update): CALL 4000-UPDATE-PORTFOLIO
  WHEN 'D' (delete): CALL 5000-DELETE-PORTFOLIO
  ELSE: SET error 'Invalid command'; CALL 9000-ERROR
END SELECT
CALL 6000-TERMINATE
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)

annotations.note: Called as a sub-routine: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-COMMAND-AREA — a reusable CRUD service, not a standalone batch job.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-WORK-AREAS
OPEN PORTFOLIO-FILE for READ-WRITE (I-O)
IF open NOT success THEN SET error 'Error opening Portfolio file'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
ACCEPT WS-CURRENT-DATE FROM system date (YYYYMMDD)
paragraphs.notes: Here 9000-ERROR does GOBACK, so the open-failure path correctly stops (unlike the batch programs).

paragraphs.name: 2000-CREATE-PORTFOLIO
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET PORTFOLIO-RECORD = LS-PORTFOLIO
CALL 2100-VALIDATE-PORTFOLIO
IF WS-RETURN-CODE <> success THEN CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
WRITE PORTFOLIO-RECORD
IF duplicate key THEN SET error 'Portfolio ID already exists'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
IF write NOT success THEN SET error 'Error writing Portfolio record'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF

paragraphs.name: 2100-VALIDATE-PORTFOLIO
paragraphs.pseudocode:
IF PORT-ID first 4 chars <> 'PORT' OR chars 5.. NOT numeric THEN
  SET error 'Invalid Portfolio ID format'; SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error; EXIT PARAGRAPH
END IF
IF PORT-NAME is blank THEN SET error 'Portfolio Name is required'; SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error; EXIT PARAGRAPH END IF
SET WS-VALID-STATUS = PORT-STATUS
IF status NOT in (A,I,C) THEN SET error 'Invalid Portfolio Status'; SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error; EXIT PARAGRAPH END IF

annotations.note: Reference-modification PORT-ID(1:4) / PORT-ID(5:5) checks the ID prefix is 'PORT' and the 5th char is numeric — the portfolio-ID business format rule. EXIT PARAGRAPH short-circuits on the first failure.

paragraphs.notes: Shared validation used by both Create and Update.

paragraphs.name: 3000-READ-PORTFOLIO
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET PORTFOLIO-RECORD = LS-PORTFOLIO   -- carries the key
READ PORTFOLIO-FILE
SELECT CASE read status
  WHEN success: SET LS-PORTFOLIO = PORTFOLIO-RECORD   -- return the record
  WHEN not found: SET error 'Portfolio not found'; CALL 9000-ERROR
  ELSE: SET error 'Error reading Portfolio'; CALL 9000-ERROR
END SELECT
branches: EVALUATE read status: success / not-found / other

paragraphs.name: 4000-UPDATE-PORTFOLIO
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET PORTFOLIO-RECORD = LS-PORTFOLIO
CALL 2100-VALIDATE-PORTFOLIO
IF WS-RETURN-CODE <> success THEN CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
REWRITE PORTFOLIO-RECORD
IF not found THEN SET error 'Portfolio not found for update'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
IF NOT success THEN SET error 'Error updating Portfolio'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
CALL 2100-LOG-PORTFOLIO-UPDATE   -- write an audit record

paragraphs.name: 5000-DELETE-PORTFOLIO
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET PORTFOLIO-RECORD = LS-PORTFOLIO   -- carries the key
DELETE PORTFOLIO-FILE record
IF not found THEN SET error 'Portfolio not found for deletion'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF
IF NOT success THEN SET error 'Error deleting Portfolio'; CALL 9000-ERROR END IF

paragraphs.name: 6000-TERMINATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLOSE PORTFOLIO-FILE
SET LS-RETURN-CODE = WS-RETURN-CODE   -- hand the outcome back to the caller

paragraphs.name: 9000-ERROR
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error (8)
CALL 6000-TERMINATE
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)
paragraphs.notes: Common error exit — closes the file and returns immediately.

paragraphs.name: 2100-HANDLE-VSAM-ERROR
paragraphs.pseudocode:
!! UNTRANSLATED / SME REVIEW: builds an ERRPROC error request from the VSAM file status and CALLs 'ERRPROC'.

  WHEN dup-key: severity=WARNING, text=VSAM-22
  WHEN not-found: severity=WARNING, text=VSAM-23
  ELSE: severity=ERROR, text=OTHER
END SELECT
CALL 'ERRPROC' PASSING LS-ERROR-REQUEST

paragraphs.name: 2100-LOG-PORTFOLIO-UPDATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
-- Audit-trail write (called after a successful update)
CLEAR LS-AUDIT-REQUEST
SET audit fields: system='PORTFOLIO', user=USERID, program='PORTMSTR', terminal=TERMINAL-ID,
    type='TRAN', action='UPDATE', status='SUCC', port id, account no,
    before-image = WS-BEFORE-IMAGE, after-image = PORT-RECORD, message='Portfolio updated successfully'
CALL 'AUDPROC' PASSING LS-AUDIT-REQUEST
